lines.say: Noise-cancelling headphones make a plane quieter by playing more sound into your ears.
lines.show: Noise-cancelling headphones make a plane *quieter* by playing [more sound] into your ears.

lines.say: Sound is just air pushing and pulling against your eardrum, in waves.
lines.show: Sound is just air *pushing* and *pulling* against your eardrum, [in waves.]

lines.say: Tiny microphones built into the headphones listen to the engine roar.
lines.show: Tiny *microphones* built into the headphones [listen to the engine roar.]

lines.say: A chip flips that wave upside down. Where the engine pushes, the headphones pull.
lines.show: A chip flips that wave *upside down.* Where the engine *pushes,* the headphones [pull.]

lines.say: The speaker plays this opposite sound, even with no music on. At your ear, the two waves meet, and much of the roar cancels out.
lines.show: The speaker plays this *opposite sound,* even with no music on. At your ear, the two waves meet, and much of the roar [cancels out.]

lines.say: It works best on low, steady rumble, like engines. Voices change too quickly to match perfectly.
lines.show: It works best on *low, steady rumble,* like engines. [Voices] change too quickly to match perfectly.

lines.say: In nineteen seventy-eight, engineer Amar Bose tried the airline's new headphones on a flight to Boston, but the engines drowned out his music. He started sketching the maths to fix it before the plane landed.
lines.show: In 1978, engineer *Amar Bose* tried the airline's new headphones on a flight to Boston, but the engines drowned out his music. He started *sketching the maths* to fix it [before the plane landed.]

lines.say: So that quiet isn't the absence of sound. It's two sound waves meeting at your ear, and mostly cancelling each other out.
lines.show: So that quiet isn't the absence of sound. It's *two sound waves* meeting at your ear, and [mostly cancelling each other out.]

lines.say: Follow for how everyday tech really works.
lines.show: Follow for how [everyday tech] really works.
